newsitem.title: UK: British Steel cuts gains after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: British Steel cuts gains after H1 results.

text.p: Shares in British Steel pared morning gains in early afternoon after in-line first half results, analysts said.

Comments that destocking appeared to be coming to an end in mainland Europe briefly pushed shares further ahead before they slipped back to be up just 2p higher at 173p, dealers citing cautious comments about the impact of recent sterling strength. The shares were up 3p at 174p immediately prior to the figures.
Pre-tax profits for the six months to September were 262 million stg, down from 550 million stg in the same period last year. Analyst forecasts had ranged from 250 to 280 million stg.
However, the company said there were signs that the destocking had come to an end in mainland Europe with price increases in structural, flat and stainless steel products.
